subject: general
question: What is a 'Firewall' in the context of network security?

options.text: A software application for managing files and folders.
A type of malware that spreads through email attachments.
A security mechanism that filters and controls network traffic.
A hardware device used to boost network performance.

solution:
The correct answer is** ​__A security mechanism that filters and controls network traffic__**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A firewall is a system that prevents unauthorized access to a private network.
 
• It is a type of cybersecurity tool that is used to filter traffic on a network.
 
• A firewall will create a barrier between a secured internal network and an unsafe external network.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Firewalls are of two types namely
 
 
• Network firewalls: Use to protect whole computer networks from attacks.
 
• Host-based firewalls.: Installed on servers or host computers to protect them from attacks.
